frozenCalibrationAdapter.name: frozen-binary-calibration-lookup-v1
frozenCalibrationAdapter.scope: Saved binary alpha_n only for n<160. All original source cells, far transfers, graphs, physical quadrature and arithmetic order are retained. Global warp alpha is the saved binary datum. No recalibration, truncated head, new deep metric or nonlinear solution.

source_adapter.scope: The saved original binary alpha_n and global warp alpha are reused through a source-hash-locked lookup. All original physical formulas, arithmetic order, 160 cells and auxiliary far transfers remain; five- and seven-fraction historical fingerprints are checked. No rational deep replacement or physical recalibration.

rows.source: flat source limit; finite160-cell primitive representative

definition: The original background is retained as a source function. heightFromRToCut is its native primitive from r to the cut. The flat-cuff value uses all160 saved source cells and records the conditional omitted rotational tail.
limitations: Floating source evaluation and primitives, not interval-certified values.
The nonzero finite nonaxisymmetric collar is separate; no infinite nonlinear solution is implied.
